audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart was incoherent: Level 1 read 'Skill' while its own why says it is your worst level in the game, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 read 'Skill' while the whys describe Riven snowballing and executing you, and First item / 2+ items read 'Riven' while spikes[3] and the late prose say the matchup flips once your HP stacks.
audit.why: Riven owns the whole laning phase (Broken Wings 13s three-cast, Ki Burst stun, Valor shield) and falls off into two tank items; the 51.8% Emerald+ win rate is carried by the post-lane half, not by an even lane.
audit.corrected: Riven wins Levels 1 through 6; First item is Skill; 2+ items is Dr. Mundo. Proposed as one atomic chart group across content win[] and full phases[].side/.rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] gave Riven the first-item window outright and whys[6] gave Mundo the two-item window, but both rows were labelled 'Riven' — the spikes narrative and the chart disagreed.
audit.why: Her Eclipse/Profane spike lands near your Heartsteel; the real flip is the second HP item, not the first.
audit.corrected: First item even (Skill), 2+ items Dr. Mundo, with whys[5] restated as a race rather than a Riven lead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Prose repeatedly blamed 'your Q Infected Bonesaw's long cooldown'. Infected Bonesaw is a 4-second cooldown — the shortest spell in the matchup. The real cost is that it is paid in health, and that it only slows. Riven's abilities were also unnamed outside of R.
audit.why: Kit file: Mundo Q cd 4, cost paid in health, flags projectile + slow. Riven Q 13s with three casts, W 11/10/9/8/7 stun, E 10/9/8/7/6 dash + shield.
audit.corrected: Cooldown claim removed everywhere; Broken Wings, Ki Burst and Valor named with real numbers, and Mundo's passive is now pointed at Ki Burst — the one immobilizing effect in her kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns lists Ki Burst at 11s with no rank context; it is 9s at rank 3 and 7s maxed.

edits.before: At 2 she adds a second Q dash and out-trades your long Q cooldown.
edits.after: At 2 Broken Wings has a second cast and each Bonesaw costs you health.

edits.before: Level 3 completes her combo — Q-E-W burst overwhelms your weak sustain.
edits.after: Level 3 completes Broken Wings into Valor and Ki Burst — a full burst chain.

edits.before: At 6 her R burst still kills you through your fresh Maximum Dosage.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile plus Wind Slash still executes through your R.

edits.before: Her first-item spike keeps her combo lethal ahead of your first tank item.
edits.after: Her Eclipse spike races your Heartsteel — even, decided by her Ki Burst use.

edits.before: Riven's full kit online — three Q dashes, W stun, E shield — lets her animation-cancel burst you repeatedly while your Q Infected Bonesaw's long cooldown and thin early regen leave you no way to trade back.
edits.after: Riven's full kit online — Broken Wings' three casts, Ki Burst's stun, Valor's shielded step — lets her animation-cancel burst you again and again, and Bonesaw is only a slow: it costs health you cannot yet regenerate.

edits.before: Riven dominates from the moment her kit comes online. Q dashes, W stun and E shield let her burst you again and again, and your Q Infected Bonesaw cooldown plus weak early regen mean you simply cannot trade back. Play for XP, dodge her W stun, and don't contest the wave when she holds a full combo.
edits.after: Riven dominates from the moment her kit comes online. Broken Wings dashes three times on a 13s cooldown, Ki Burst stuns, and Valor blocks damage — she bursts you again and again, and your Bonesaw only slows. Play for XP, keep your passive canister for her Ki Burst, and never contest the wave while she holds all three Q casts.

edits.before: That spell is what punishes you — only step up once it’s down or baited.
edits.after: Ki Burst is 9s at rank 3 — step up only once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Save your defensive tool for survival and spacing.
edits.after: Your passive eats one Ki Burst — do not waste it.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Infected Bonesaw's' — FALSE POSITIVE on the name (that is Mundo's real Q), but the sentence around it was factually wrong and is fixed: Infected Bonesaw is a 4s cooldown, not a long one. Level-chart edits are submitted as one group (win[0],[3],[4],[5],[6] plus phases[0],[3],[4],[5],[6].side and two ratings); win[1]/win[2] and phases[1]/[2] already read Riven and are unchanged. Note the packet levelChart gives Riven 6/7 with Mundo only at 2+ items, which is what this proposal converges on.
